provenance: nested pool counts from 2011; pools sized by 2014 roll carried to 2016 on the 2011-2014 RATE of change (log-space, invariant to a constant level bias), damped x0.6; roster published; reach 2016 ward ballot
rates_on_a_bound: Indian/Asian: adult_share fitted to 1.0000, which is ON A BOUND — the ward table cannot identify this pool at this level. The value is a clipped corner and not a measurement. Largest share this pool reaches in any ward: 20.6%.
